notes: PROPOSED, drafted 18 Sep 2026 — NOT yet reviewed by an architect. Scope: the technology capabilities the use case's own FUNCTIONS demand. Cross-cutting capabilities every solution needs (identity, observability, the gateway, evaluation, evidence retention) are deliberately excluded: they are derived by the composition as unconditional families, not matched from a behavioural element, and including them would make every case's expected set largely identical and inflate recall for free.
lock: FROZEN 18 Sep 2026. This set is the BAR and is never edited after reading a result — adding what the matcher returned raises precision and recall arithmetically, which is the textbook way to inflate a score, and it happened here: a widening on 18 Sep moved recall +0.05 and precision +0.24 while measuring nothing. A set that is wrong is re-derived BLIND from submission.md alone, with no results open, or by an architect — never reconciled against the output it exists to judge.
widening_rule: A capability belongs here if a NAMED FUNCTION in this case's own element inventory cannot be delivered without it. Function-grounded, not matcher-grounded: the justification cites the function, so a reviewer can check it without reading a single result.
